chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Allah loves from the good deeds that which is hastened.'
ai.seo_question: What does Islam say about hastening good deeds?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith underscores the spiritual merit of immediacy in worship, reflecting the Shia emphasis on seizing opportunities for good before they pass. It highlights that Allah’s pleasure is specifically linked to the prompt execution of righteous acts, encouraging believers to avoid procrastination in fulfilling their religious duties.
